S.FORM: Vietnam u Vietnam sa i labu nu Ya-Cuo, itiza i 16 10 N, 107 50 E. u ahebal nu lala' mapulung sa izaw ku 331,210 km2. u ahebal nu lala'ay sa izaw ku 310,070 km2, u ahebal nu nanumay sa izaw ku 21,140 km2. hamin nu tademawan sa 95,261,021. kakalukan umah sa 34.80%, kilakilangan umah sa 45%, zumaay henay umah sa 20.20%. tapang tusu nu kanatal u tapang tusu nu kanatal sa u Hanoi . kakinginan nu kanatal demiad kakinging nu kanatal demiad sa tusa bulad siwa demiad. tabakiay a tapang nu kanatal u tabakiay a tapang nu kanatal (cong-tung) ayza sa ci Trần Đại Quang, micakat a demiad sa i 2016 a mihca sepat bulad tusa demiad. Hanoi 河內市(越南語:Thành phố Hà Nội) (越南語:Sông Tô Lịch) . Hanoi u satabakiay a tukay nu Vietnam . u Hanoi i amis nu Vietnam , teban nu satip atu amis, kawanan nu Hung-He atu Tan-Te-Ciyang , i teban nu Hung-He atu kakumudan nu Hung-He , Tan-Te-Ciyang i teban nu Hung-He atu Tan-Te-Ciyang sisa pangangan han tu Hanoi . u lumlum nu Kuziw kacapuan nu selangawan kalimulakan i ayaw nu Ye-Nan , 1000 a mihca ku likisi. namaka 1000 a mihca nu kalecuhan ni Ye-Su (11 a se-ci ), u tapan tu nu Ye-Nan i tukay yadah ku mukasiay a kining piyadahan 800 a mang ku tademaw, Cing-Cu ku katuuday. likisi nu Hanoi 公元前2世紀, ". ayaw hen nu 200 a mihcaan nu kalecuhan ni Jesus , laisan nu Han-Caw ku amis nu Vietnam patizeng han tu Cin kenis , cacay a malebutay a mihcaan a kuwanan nu China . Hanoi mala nikuwanan nu Ciyaw-Ce-Song-Pin kenis . 622 a mihca, u Tang-Caw nu China ku mikuwanay tu Ciyaw-Ce , Re-Nan atu Ciyu-Cen patizengan tu Ciyaw-Cu-Cung-Kuwan-Fu . likul u An-Nan-Tu-Hu-Fu An-Nan han ku China . 1428年, . i 1428 a mihca Li-Caw a tapang nu mikeliday ci Li-Li mademec ku hitay nu Mi-Caw nu China , patizeng han tu Li-Caw . i Sen-Lung-Ceng hantu ku satabakiay a tukay (Hanoi han ayza). 1802 a mihcaan patizeng han tu Zuwan-Caw . 1873 a mihca, debungan nu Fa-Kuo ku Hanoi . 1888 a mihca papechnen nu Zuwan-Caw ku Hanoi , Hay-Fang-Su atu Sin-Kang ku France . i 1902 a mihca, linghen nu France ku tapang a tukay. namaka Sai Kung (ayca a Hu-Ci-Min patayzaen i Hanoi . 1940 a mihca, mademec ku Lipun a malais. tapang nu mikeliday ci Hu-Ci-Min nu Ye-Meng , laisan i waluay a bulad, patizeng han Ye-Nan-Min-Cu-Kung-He-Kuo patizeng han ku satabakiyay a tukay i Hanoi . 1946 a mihcaan midebung aca ku France i Hanoi , miliyas ku Ye-Mung tayza milimek i buyubuyuan mala yu-ci-tuey maka siwa a mihcaan, i 1945 a mihca, maalaw aca nu Pey-Ye ku Hanoi . i "nakalas nu Vietnam " (1955-1975), u zazan atu kayak a nu kazizeng, silamalay mamin a mapeci, nika kalah masanga' masinanut nu tademaw nu Ye-Nan. 1976 a mihcaan pitu a bulad sakatusa a demiad, malimuut makedet, masinanut ku kanatal nu Vietnam . u Hanoi ku salikulay a tapang nu tukay. Hu-Ci-Min tukay Si-Kung han i ayaw ku Hu-Ci-Min tukay nanu satabakiay a tukay nu Vietnam , u tatebanan nu sakaudip, pisiwbayan, pakacawan nu silamalay atu basu, u tatebanan nu selangawan nu binacadan. u nipangangan tu tatebanan nu mikeliday nu Vietnam ci Hu-Ci-Min tukay . 132. Hu-Ci-Min tukay , Tu-Long-Mu-Su , I-An-Su atu Sun-An-Su nu Pin-Yang kenis , Piyan-Hu-Su nu Tung-Nay kenis atu capiay a niyazu'. malawit ku 900 a mang nu tademaw. u Hu-Ci-Min tukay ku satabakiay a tukay i Vietnam atu "ayaw nikuwanan nu France a kanatal Ing-Tu-Ce-Nan " (u nikuwanan nu Fa-Lan-Si Ti-Kuo i Tung-Nan-Ya ), malaba amin ku niyazu', teban nu wili atu timu Ciya-Ciyen-Ciyang atu Lung-An kenis , 30 km2 adahal nu pala. 20 a mang ku tademaw. i 2020 a mihca, u kamu nu Mey-Su (美世, Merecer), Cin-Ci-Siye-Sin-Si-Pu atu Fey-Cuo-Ku-Cin-Ci Wi Huy . u tekes nu tukay i sikay u saka 132 ku Hu-Ci-Min tukay . Hu-Ci-Min tukay satalakaway a yuping . i teban nu maci nu Sai Kung ku satalakaway a yuping. u singanganay a luma nu France i Sai Kung . u Fa-Kuo hen a nipikuwan a nisangaan i likul nu 19 a se-ci . u kalawlaway a kulid ku cabeng nu nisanga'an a luma'. salungan ku lalabu nu luma' mahaen nu mukasi. mahida u pangciw nu mali ku badahung. masakimulmulay a malikatay a sasingalan. . u sasing ni Hu-Ci-Min mapacait tu i teban nu tumunaw, i pabaw nu kawanan atu kawili idaw ku nikulitan tu kitidaan nu tademaw a kitakit nu France a ti-li-siye-cia a nikulitan. i tamunaw izaw ku sumanahay nisangaan tu patelian tu sapatelay tu baaday a kitakit u balakiay tu a yubin. tayzaay a labang midang i Hu-Ci-Min aka pawan micakay tu minsinpen. Sen-Mu-Ma-Li-Ya kiwkay (聖母瑪莉亞教堂, Notre Dame Cathedral) . sumanahay a kiwkay nipatizeng yu France hen ku mikuwanay, sumanahay a kiwkay, i ayaw nu satabakiay a yubing, u salungan a nipatizeng a luma', nika caay ka tanektek ya kiwkay nipatudung tu Paris Sen-Mu-Yuen pacaitan tu cung a badahung 40 m ku takalaw namakazaay amis i France ku sapisanga.u cabeng i putah u sumanahay a lingka ku sapisanga tu madicemay a badahung, u labu nu kiwkay mahica u nu Ke-Teay a luma', yu kulikulitan a sasingalan atu masamulmulay a tenciw . ayaw nu kiwkay patizengan tu nisangaan ci Ma-Li-Yaan . 1945 a mihca nipakining nu Luo-Ma kiwkay .
